pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev_memories_tests.rs:21 dev_memories_tests.rs builds a private shared-cache in-memory pool per test and re-runs the full initial and incremental migration chain each time (about 16 tests). It bypasses the copied template every sibling repo test here uses (twin, metrics, fk_hygiene, fleet_sessions, system_ops) and skips the standard pragmas and builtin seeds, so it pays N×build and certifies a schema shaped differently from production.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev_memories_tests.rs:21 A rebuild per test, which the technique names as the failure. The crate's own init_test_db does it right: build once and copy (src-tauri/db/src/lib.rs:2473), with a probe at handoff (:2487). Seeds go through the product door (test_fixtures.rs:10), though fk_hygiene.rs:685 inserts personas raw.

src-tauri/db/src/lib.rs:2333 The template is per-pid, the stale template is reaped at startup, and stale per-test copies are swept once per process. dev_memories also gives each test its own DB name (dev_memories_tests.rs:12).
